_README: Only for facts that cannot be read from the statute's own page and were
checked against another edition. Every entry records what was checked and
against what, so the correction can be re-tested rather than trusted.
The original wording is always kept alongside as heading_raw.

SRC031.note: Structure reviewed against the source page: 23 Parts, 106 crossheadings, 3 subheadings, 534 sections and 13 referenced schedules, all confirmed. Section 1 sits outside Part I in the source, so it is a top-level node.

SRC011.note: HTML extraction only, as instructed; the RGD PDF was not merged. Structure reviewed: 9 crossheadings, sections 1-75 complete, 14 definitions in s.75, 4 provisos (ss.20, 45, 46, 59). The two source errors below survive in the HTML as well as the PDF and are recorded, not corrected.

SRC077.note: HTML extraction, checked against the revised-edition PDF at https://lankalaw.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/roodai137463.pdf. Sections 1-12 complete, 3 provisos, 1 term defined in s.11 and 1 scoped to s.2(1), four listed Ordinances in s.2(3), no Parts or Schedules.

quality_notes.detail: Section 12(1) items (i) to (iii) sit directly under the subsection. Paragraph (b) exists, so an (a) container is missing from the source markup. Not synthesised here, because inventing a container would change the tree on inference alone.

Section 12 prints "had, been", "for;,;the registration", "instrument.." and "Registrar- General". Left as printed; the intended wording is "had been", "for the registration", "instrument." and "Registrar-General".

The Supreme Court note applies to references in ss.4 and 5, and the former Secretary of the District Court note to ss.5(7) and 7(7). Notes are recorded at section level only, so those multiple anchors are not preserved.
Not captured: s.5(8) to Chapter XVII of the Civil Procedure Code, s.7(7) to ss.7(2) to 7(5), and s.11 to s.8(a) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance at paragraph level.

SRC072.note: HTML extraction. 5 Parts; 30 sections numbered 1-29 and 31, the source itself having no section 30. 9 definitions in s.31(1), 1 proviso, and one Schedule referenced by s.26(2)(b) whose text is not on the page.
SRC072.commencement_caveat: statute_commencement.csv gives 1968-06-22, which the page prints as the date of assent. Editorial notes on the page say operation was fixed for 3rd January 1970 by Order in Gazette No. 14,884 of 12 December 1969. The two dates answer different questions and neither is corrected here.
